+- `artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/evidence-governance-audit-contract.v1.md`
+- `artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/evidence-backfill-final-gate.v1.json`
+- `artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/evidence-backfill-final-gate.validator-result.json`
+
+These artifacts are source inputs for governance only. Downstream workers must cite them, preserve their source identities, and create derived artifacts instead of mutating them.
+
+## Governed Asset States
+
+Every downstream row must be classified into exactly one primary governed asset state and may carry secondary route hints. The primary state controls the next action.
+
+| state | definition | required posture |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `procedure_model_candidate` | A reusable method-level ProcedureModel candidate with bounded topic, paper, visual-method, method-label, and adjacent-method evidence. | Candidate-only. Requires evidence beyond `topic_path` alone. |
+| `procedure_step_candidate` | A repeatable step/action inside or shared across procedure candidates, supported by source-span or equivalent evidence. | Candidate-only. Shared step evidence must not be inflated into a ProcedureModel merge/split decision. |
+| `strategy_model_candidate` | A higher-level strategy route, planning heuristic, or method-selection behavior rather than a repeatable executable procedure. | Route to StrategyModel candidate backlog. Do not collapse into ProcedureModel. |
+| `exam_trigger_or_question_pattern_candidate` | A question-shape, cue, visual pattern, part-scope trigger, or exam-surface trigger that helps identify when a method may apply. | Route to ExamTrigger/QuestionPattern backlog. It is not a ProcedureModel by itself. |
+| `topic_skill_or_interpretation_skill_candidate` | A content skill, topic subskill, interpretation skill, symbol-reading skill, or graph/table reading skill. | Route to TopicSkill/InterpretationSkill backlog. It is not a ProcedureModel unless method evidence also exists. |
+| `failure_point_candidate` | An error pattern, misconception, omission, fragile substep, or weak point observed in evidence or blockers. | Route to FailurePoint backlog. It may reference a ProcedureStep but does not replace it. |
+| `evidence_backlog` | A row blocked by missing PDF/visual/source-span/source-identity/provenance evidence or manual extraction requirements. | Must remain blocked or unserved until evidence is extracted and cited. |
+| `human_semantic_decision` | A row requiring human semantic judgment, including merge/split, compound-anchor handling, broad wording, adjacent-method boundary, or part-scope decisions. | Must remain blocked unless a later explicit human-owner decision artifact is consumed. |
+| `unserved_backlog` | A governed row outside the strict V1 served subset, including cold long-tail, unresolved evidence, unresolved human decisions, or out-of-scope asset routes. | Must stay out of served/runtime paths. |
+
+## Required Row Fields For Downstream Artifacts
+
+Any downstream inventory, scheduler, candidate ledger, or gate artifact governed by this contract must include enough structure for deterministic validation:
+
+| field | requirement |
+| --- | --- |
+| `source_row_id` | Stable source row, blocker, mapping, handoff, or candidate identifier. |
+| `source_artifact_refs` | Non-empty repo-relative source refs with row pointers or equivalent row-local receipts. |
+| `governed_asset_state` | One primary state from the governed asset-state table. |
+| `secondary_route_hints` | Optional secondary hints, never a replacement for primary state. |
+| `route_reason_ids` | Explicit reasons for the state and next action. |
+| `evidence_posture` | One of `sufficient_candidate_evidence`, `manual_extraction_required`, `human_semantic_decision_required`, `weak_or_missing_provenance`, or `not_served_in_v1`. |
+| `served_boundary_status` | One of `served_v1_candidate_pool`, `unserved_backlog`, or `blocked_pending_governance`. |
+| `human_owner_decision_required` | Boolean. True when semantic acceptance, merge/split, wording, or part-scope judgment is needed. |
+| `human_owner_decision_artifact_ref` | Required only when a later issue explicitly consumes a human-owner decision artifact. |
+| `next_action` | One of `carry_forward`, `manual_extract`, `route_to_asset_backlog`, `require_human_semantic_decision`, `candidate_only_keep`, `candidate_only_split`, or `candidate_only_merge`. |
+| `runtime_path_eligible` | Must be false unless the row is inside the strict V1 served subset and has no unresolved blocker. |
